item.title: 3D, layered and inline typefaces
item.description:
I’m looking for examples of quality, multi-weight 3d, bevelled, inline and layered display typefaces.

I’m thinking along the lines of Conqueror, History, Matryoshka, HF&J’s shades collections and RM&Co’s new one Utopia ( http://rossimazzei.com/work/eventi-letterari/)

Any ideas for others?

Thanks
